sentences.en: This spider can have a leg span of up 6 inches.
sentences.zh: 这只蜘蛛的腿展可达6英寸。

sentences.en: The present perfect expresses the long span from past to present.
sentences.zh: 现在完成时表达了从过去到现在的长时段。

sentences.en: My son's short attention span is causing him problems at school.
sentences.zh: 我儿子注意力不集中，这在学校给他带来了麻烦。
